edges.reason: Ownable constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable
msg.sender is the untrusted source of initial ownership
onlyOwner modifier on renounceOwnership compares msg.sender to owner
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership using msg.sender
transferOwnership delegates to internal _transferOwnership
_transferOwnership writes the new owner address
setTokenMinter writes the tokenMinter state variable
onlyOwner guard restricts setTokenMinter to msg.sender == owner
hasMintPermission reads tokenMinter to authorize msg.sender
hasMintPermission compares msg.sender against owner and tokenMinter
WarfieldToken.mint calls super.mint resolving to CappedToken.mint
CappedToken.mint calls super.mint resolving to MintableToken.mint
cap check reads totalSupply_ when validating the new supply
require(totalSupply_.add(_amount) <= cap) bounds minted amount
mint performs the unchecked addition on totalSupply_
addition result is stored back into totalSupply_
mint increases balances[_to] with SafeMath add
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] as the debited account
transfer applies sub/add arithmetic to the balances mapping
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] as spender authorization
transferFrom decreases allowance with SafeMath sub
transferFrom updates both source and destination balances
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key
increaseApproval adds _addedValue to the allowance
decreaseApproval subtracts _subtractedValue from the allowance
finishMinting sets mintingFinished = true terminating mint rights
onlyOwner modifier guards finishMinting with msg.sender == owner
canMint modifier requires mintingFinished to be false
canTransfer modifier requires mintingFinished before transfer
canTransfer modifier gates WarfieldToken.transferFrom
WarfieldToken.transfer delegates to super.transfer
WarfieldToken.transferFrom delegates to super.transferFrom
recoverTokens makes an external call via token.safeTransfer before completing
the arbitrary token parameter is the callee of the external call
the to parameter is the destination of the external token transfer
the amount parameter controls the value sent in the external call
the to parameter flows into token.safeTransfer inside recoverTokens
onlyOwner modifier guards recoverTokens against unauthorized callers
mintTokens loops and calls WarfieldToken.mint for each receiver
the _receivers array drives which addresses are minted to
the _amounts array drives how much is minted per receiver
the loop index i is initialized and incremented inside mintTokens
the loop index selects the receiver and amount passed to mint
the _tokenMinter parameter is written into the tokenMinter state variable
the _to parameter is the destination of the balance credit in transfer
the _value parameter is subtracted from and added to balances
the _from parameter indexes balances and allowed during transferFrom
the _amount parameter feeds the supply and balance additions in mint
mint relies on SafeMath.add for supply arithmetic
SafeMath.add returns the value stored into totalSupply_
transferFrom relies on SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance arithmetic
SafeMath.sub returns the value stored into the balances mapping

normalization_plan.reason: The arbitrary ERC20 token argument is only meaningful as the callee used by the recoverTokens external transfer
The destination address directly parameterizes the external token.safeTransfer call, the reentrancy-relevant operation
The amount argument is a plain value validated by the balance require inside recoverTokens
The receivers array exists solely to drive the mintTokens batch mint loop
The amounts array exists solely to drive the mintTokens batch mint loop
The new minter address is only used to update the tokenMinter state via setTokenMinter
The transfer destination address is consumed by the balance arithmetic inside BasicToken.transfer
The transfer value is consumed by the SafeMath sub/add arithmetic inside BasicToken.transfer
The source address is consumed by the balances and allowed lookups inside StandardToken.transferFrom
The mint amount flows into the supply/balance additions coordinated by WarfieldToken.mint
The loop counter only controls iteration inside the mintTokens batch function
